notes.title: Small Patch available!
notes.content:
-Hello runners!, this update fixes a small bug that occurs when starting a new game, which caused some levels to not unlock correctly.

-In addition, it is no longer necessary to be inside the button to go to the next level, you only need to touch the button once and when the word continue appears, you can go to the next level whenever you want by pressing the E on your keyboard.

-New music for the farm level is available.

We hope you enjoy this update.
RED PIXEL TEAM <3

notes.title: Sweet Paradise Update!
notes.content:
Sweet Update new content:
-Sweet Paradise level!, A new level filled with delicious desserts like ice creams, cakes, donuts, candies, and other delicious treats that we shouldn't eat, but do anyway!

Experience one of the most challenging levels in Speed ​​Run history.

-New Characters: The Sweet King and his butler Felicio.

-Vaporwave platform fixed, fixed a bug that made the starting the platform clip through the geometry, making the jump for the player unfair.

-Fixed a collision error in the debris in the Vaporwave level.

-Some minor difficulty balance made in some levels. 

-More extras added to the main menu and new concept art of the behind the scenes is available to see.
